h1: Google Shopping ads with a feed that is ready to sell
overview: Shopping ads show your products with a photo and price, so the feed behind them matters most. We connect your store to Google Merchant Center, fix missing titles, images, prices and identifiers, and set up Shopping campaigns in your Google Ads account. We group products by margin or category so budget goes where it makes sense. You receive a list of every feed issue we fixed and what remains.

faq: Which store platforms do you connect?
Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce and most stores that can export a product feed. Tell us your platform in the order form, and we confirm the best connection route before we begin.

Common causes are missing identifiers, price mismatches between feed and site, or policy issues with the page. We read the diagnostics, fix what is fixable, and tell you plainly when a product cannot be advertised.
Do you edit my product pages?
We can fix feed data without touching the page. If a mismatch has to be fixed on the product page itself, we flag it, and you can order a page-level fix from our store services.
No. Google bills your own account for clicks. We recommend a starting daily budget based on your catalog and margins, and you stay in control of the number.
